proof_body:
by
  intro a b c
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    have h := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq x
    have e : (a * Real.sin x + b * Real.cos x) ^ 2 + (a * Real.cos x - b * Real.sin x) ^ 2 = (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) * (Real.sin x ^ 2 + Real.cos x ^ 2) := by ring
    rw [h, mul_one] at e
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a * Real.cos x - b * Real.sin x)]
  · intro hc
    by_cases h0 : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 = 0
    · have ha : a = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg a, sq_nonneg b]
      have hb : b = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg a, sq_nonneg b]
      have hc0 : c = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg c]
      exact ⟨0, by simp [ha, hb, hc0]⟩
    · have hpos : 0 < a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := lt_of_le_of_ne (by positivity) (Ne.symm h0)
      have hr : 0 < Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hpos
      obtain ⟨α, hca, hsa⟩ : ∃ α : ℝ, Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) * Real.cos α = a ∧ Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) * Real.sin α = b := by
        have hn : ‖(⟨a, b⟩ : ℂ)‖ = Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by
          rw [Complex.norm_def, Complex.normSq_apply]
          congr 1
          ring
        have h1 := Complex.norm_mul_cos_arg (⟨a, b⟩ : ℂ)
        have h2 := Complex.norm_mul_sin_arg (⟨a, b⟩ : ℂ)
        rw [hn] at h1 h2
        exact ⟨_, h1, h2⟩
      have hb : |c| ≤ Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := Real.abs_le_sqrt hc
      have h1 : -1 ≤ c / Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ hr]
        linarith [(abs_le.mp hb).1]
      have h2 : c / Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) ≤ 1 := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hr]
        linarith [(abs_le.mp hb).2]
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y : ℝ, Real.sin y = c / Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := ⟨_, Real.sin_arcsin h1 h2⟩
      refine ⟨y - α, ?_⟩
      have hu : Real.sin y = Real.sin (y - α) * Real.cos α + Real.cos (y - α) * Real.sin α := by
        rw [← Real.sin_add, sub_add_cancel]
      have hc' : Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) * Real.sin y = c := by
        rw [hy]
        field_simp
      rw [← hc', hu]
      linear_combination (-Real.sin (y - α)) * hca - Real.cos (y - α) * hsa
target_source: ∀ a b c : ℝ, (∃ x : ℝ, a * Real.sin x + b * Real.cos x = c) ↔ c ^ 2 ≤ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2
